lines.plain: ن وهي في السمت من دائرة
نقطة ا هي سمت الجزء الغارب

lines.text: قائمة حَيْثُ تقطَع خطّ {ov:ه د} دائِرةَ{n:3}
lines.plain: قائمة حَيْثُ تقطَع خطّ ه د دائِرةَ

lines.text: بَيَّنَّا في القمر والشمس وفي هذا كَفَى به شامِلُهُ وذلك ما أَرَدْنا أن نُبَيِّن إِن شاء اللّٰه.
lines.plain: بَيَّنَّا في القمر والشمس وفي هذا كَفَى به شامِلُهُ وذلك ما أَرَدْنا أن نُبَيِّن إِن شاء اللّٰه.

lines.text: في مَعْرِفة مواضع الكواكب المتحيِّرة من فلك البروج بتأْريخ العَرَب والرُّوم.{mR:15}
lines.plain: في مَعْرِفة مواضع الكواكب المتحيِّرة من فلك البروج بتأْريخ العَرَب والرُّوم.

lines.text: قال اذا اردتَّ معرفة موضع أيّ الكواكب المُتَحَيِّرة اردتَّ فٱعْرِف وَسَط الكوكب في اليوم الذي
lines.plain: قال اذا اردتَّ معرفة موضع أيّ الكواكب المُتَحَيِّرة اردتَّ فٱعْرِف وَسَط الكوكب في اليوم الذي

lines.text: تُريد والساعة المفروضة بساعات الرَّقَّة بأَيّ التأْريخَيْن شِئْتَ على ما وصَفْتُ *في معرفة وَسَط الشمس{mL:f. 117,r.}
lines.plain: تُريد والساعة المفروضة بساعات الرَّقَّة بأَيّ التأْريخَيْن شِئْتَ على ما وصَفْتُ *في معرفة وَسَط الشمس

lines.text: واعرف وسط الشمس ايضًا في ذلك الوَقْت الذي تعرِف فيه وسط الكوكب وإِن كان حِسابك لزُحَلَ
lines.plain: واعرف وسط الشمس ايضًا في ذلك الوَقْت الذي تعرِف فيه وسط الكوكب وإِن كان حِسابك لزُحَلَ

lines.text: والمُشْتَرِي والمِرِّيخ فانقُص وسط أيّها حسَبْتَ له من وسط الشمس فما بَقِيَ فهو حاصَّة الكوكب وان{mR:20}
lines.plain: والمُشْتَرِي والمِرِّيخ فانقُص وسط أيّها حسَبْتَ له من وسط الشمس فما بَقِيَ فهو حاصَّة الكوكب وان

lines.text: كان حِسابك للزُّهَرَة وعُطارِدَ فإِنّ الذي يخرُج لك من الجَدْوَل هو حاصَّة الكوكب ووَسَط الشمس
lines.plain: كان حِسابك للزُّهَرَة وعُطارِدَ فإِنّ الذي يخرُج لك من الجَدْوَل هو حاصَّة الكوكب ووَسَط الشمس

notes.text: 1) In cod. superest tantum prima pars litterae س — 2) Cod. سمت — 3) Cod. من; Plato pro

observations: L06, L07, L10, L18: long joins (سمـت on L06; الأُفـق on L10; حاصَّـة on L18) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of يكون (L07).

The page ends chapter 44 beside its figure and begins chapter 45. L01 to L10 stand in a column at the right of the page (411 to 540 pt), beside the figure; L11 runs from the right edge of the measure (540.6 pt) and ends the chapter: it is short (it ends at 171.9 pt) and closed by a full stop. After a space stands the heading of chapter 45 on L12, in the larger type, centred (241.8 to 410.2 pt), and after another space its title on L13, centred as well (171.6 to 482.2 pt) and closed by a full stop. L14 to L18 run the full measure (116 to 541 pt); L14, the first line of the chapter, is set in (it begins at 516.8 pt). Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L13 (the title) and L17: they count the lines of the grid of the page (26.7 pt from line to line), with the spaces about the heading and the title: the title stands on the fifteenth line of the grid, the heading between the thirteenth and the fourteenth, and L14 to L18 on the seventeenth to the twenty-first. The folio number «f. 116,v.» stands in the left margin beside L03, at the left of the figure, where the asterisk stands before ومعلوم; the folio number «f. 117,r.» stands in the left margin beside L15, where the asterisk stands before في معرفة. Under a rule of 100.5 pt (117.7 to 218.2 pt) stand three notes in two lines, the first set in (144.4 to 541.8 pt), the second from the left edge (116.6 to 263.4 pt), closed by a full stop.

The figure of the eclipse of the sun stands at the left of the page, beside L01 to L10 (135 to 395.5 pt across and 143 to 362 pt down, with its words from 113.5 pt across and from 120 to 378.5 pt down). It is redrawn: two circles about one centre (radii 106.3 and 67.2 pt), the greater one the circle of the half of the two diameters and the smaller one the circle of the sun of the text of p. 170; the upright and the level diameter of the greater circle; three circles of one size (radius 39.3 pt), the circles of the moon: one at the right and one at the lower left, with their centres on the greater circle, and one under the centre of the figure, about a point of the upright diameter that is printed as a filled dot (3.5 pt across); and four more lines: two from the centre of the figure to the centres of the circles at the right and at the lower left, and two level ones, from the upright diameter to the centre of the circle at the right and from the centre of the circle at the lower left to the upright diameter. Its twenty letters and words stand where they are printed. The words «جنوب» (over the figure), «مشرق» (at its left), «مغرب» (at its right, inside the circle of the moon that stands there) and «شمال» (under it) are printed without the article and without signs. The letters: ج at the left end of the level diameter and ا at its right end, both over the line and inside the greater circle; at the right of the upright diameter, from the top down, ب under its top, ز under the top of the circle of the sun, ه at the centre, ع where the level line from the right meets it, ح beside the filled dot, ض over the foot of the circle of the sun, م where the level line from the left meets it, and د over its foot; ك and ل at the left and at the right of ض, beside the points where the circle of the moon about ح cuts the circle of the sun; ق beside the centre of the circle at the right and س beside the centre of the circle at the lower left; ط and ن beside the lines from the centre to ق and to س, at the points where those two circles touch the circle of the sun. The hā' is printed as a small ring. The letters ط, ض and س and the last letter of «مغرب» touch the drawing in the print. The upright diameter has a gap of 0.6 pt under the filled dot, which is not redrawn.

Letters of the figure, in a smaller type, under bars: on L02 {ov:ن} (13.4 pt); on L03 {ov:س ج} under one bar (18.2 pt), the sīn in its free form with its tail; on L04 {ov:ا} (13.6 pt); on L05 {ov:ج} (13.2 pt); on L08 {ov:ه د} under one bar (12.8 pt), the hā' printed as a small filled ring.

The note figures: the figure 1 stands on L03 after {ov:س ج}, before the asterisk; the figure 2 on L04 after نقطة, before {ov:ا}; the figure 3 on L08 after دائِرةَ, at the end of the line. The notes: of the letter س only the first part is left in the codex; the codex has سمت for نقطة and من for دائرة; for دائرة الافق Plato has «hemisphaerium». In the notes سمت has the two dots of its tā', and دائرة the hamza over its tooth and the two dots of its last letter; الافق is printed without a hamza and without signs.
L01: no signs. الانجلاء: the nūn stands as a small hook with its dot over the jīm, as on the pages before; the hamza stands on the line after the alif.
L02: دائرة: the bare hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt); no sign under the tooth and none over the last letter (compare L08).

L03: الأُفْق: over the lām-alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.8 pt), and a round sukun over the dot of the fā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too on L09 (3.6 x 6.1 and 2.5 x 2.5 pt) and on L10 (3.2 x 6.1 and 2.5 x 2.5 pt). قوْس: a round sukun over the wāw (2.9 x 2.5 pt) and no other sign: the two joined dots that stand over the qāf, 15.1 to 16.9 pt over the baseline of L03 (3.6 x 1.8 pt), are the dots of the yā' of وهي on L02 (9.4 pt under its baseline), in both copies; the two dots of the qāf itself stand 4.7 to 6.8 pt over the baseline. أنّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.6 x 2.5 pt).
L04, L05, L07: no signs. الجزء (L04, L05): the hamza on the line.

L06: وَسَط: a fatha over the wāw and a fatha over the sīn, printed joined into one long stroke (7.6 x 4.3 pt), in both copies; so too on L15 (7.6 x 3.6 pt). On L14 and on L18 (ووَسَط) the two fathas stand apart (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt; 3.2 x 2.2 pt each). وسط on L09, on L16 (twice) and on L17 (twice) has no signs.

L08: قائمة: the bare hamza over its tooth (3.2 x 3.2 pt). حَيْثُ: a fatha over the ḥā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a damma over the thā' (2.2 x 4.3 pt). تقطَع: a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). خطّ: a shadda over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt). دائِرةَ: the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt), a kasra under the tooth (3.2 x 2.2 pt, 5.4 to 7.5 pt under the baseline) and a fatha over the two dots of the last letter (3.6 x 2.2 pt, 11.2 to 13.3 pt over the baseline; the dots stand 5.8 to 7.9 pt over it), in both copies; the figure 3 follows.
L09: بحَسَب: a fatha over the ḥā' and a fatha over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt each). بُعْده: a damma over the bā' (2.2 x 5.0 pt) and a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt).
L10: وقُرْبه: a damma over the qāf, above its dots (2.5 x 4.7 pt), and a round sukun over the rā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt).

L11: بَيَّنَّا: a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt); over the nūn a fatha (3.6 x 2.2 pt) with a shadda under it, which is joined to the head of the last alif in both copies. كَفَى: a fatha over the kāf and a fatha over the fā' (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has no dots. شامِلُهُ: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a damma over the lām (2.2 x 4.3 pt) and a damma over the hā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt). أَرَدْنا: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the rā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.2 x 2.5 pt). أن: the bare hamza (2.9 x 3.2 pt). نُبَيِّن: a damma over the nūn (2.2 x 4.3 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the two dots of the yā', joined to them in the master scan (3.2 x 3.6 pt together) and apart from them in the second copy. إِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it, in one cluster in the master scan (2.9 x 4.7 pt), the kasra apart in the second copy. شاء: the hamza on the line. اللّٰه: a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt) with the upright alif over it (1.4 x 3.2 pt); the full stop follows.
L12 (the heading): no signs; والاربعون without a hamza.

L13 (the title): مَعْرِفة: a fatha over the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). المتحيِّرة: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under its two dots (3.6 x 2.2 pt, 6.1 to 8.3 pt under the baseline; the dots, 3.2 x 1.8 pt, stand 3.6 to 5.4 pt under it, on the foot of the join of the yā' and the rā'); no other signs (compare L14). بتأْريخ: over the alif the hamza with a round sukun above it in one cluster (2.9 x 5.0 pt); the two dots of the yā' are cast as a short bar in the hollow of the join of the yā' and the khā', as on pp. 104 to 106. العَرَب: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a short fatha over the rā' (2.5 x 1.8 pt). والرُّوم: over the rā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt).

L14: قال: the two dots of the qāf are joined to the head of the letter, in both copies. اردتَّ (twice): over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt; 3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); no hamza. أيّ: the bare hamza over the alif (2.5 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). المُتَحَيِّرة: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a fatha over the tā', above its two dots (3.2 x 1.8 pt), a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a shadda over the yā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under its two dots (3.6 x 2.2 pt). فٱعْرِف: the waṣla over the alif (3.2 x 2.9 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L15: تُريد: a damma over the tā' (2.5 x 4.0 pt). الرَّقَّة: over the rā' and over the qāf a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt; 3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). بأَيّ: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.9 pt). التأْريخَيْن: over the alif the hamza with a round sukun above it in one cluster (3.2 x 5.8 pt), a fatha over the khā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the second yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). شِئْتَ: a kasra under the shīn (2.5 x 1.8 pt), the hamza over its tooth with a sukun above it in one cluster (3.2 x 6.1 pt) and a fatha over the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). وصَفْتُ: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the fā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a damma over the tā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt).

L16: واعرف: no signs (compare L14). ايضًا: the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt). الوَقْت: a fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the qāf, above its dots (2.5 x 2.9 pt). تعرِف: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). وإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it, in one cluster in the master scan (3.2 x 4.3 pt), the kasra apart in the second copy. حِسابك: a kasra under the ḥā' (2.9 x 1.8 pt); so too on L18 (2.9 x 2.2 pt). لزُحَلَ: a damma over the zāy (2.2 x 4.3 pt), a fatha over the ḥā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the lām (2.9 x 1.8 pt).

L17: والمُشْتَرِي: a damma over the mīm (2.9 x 4.0 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has its two dots. والمِرِّيخ: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), a shadda over the rā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under it (3.6 x 1.8 pt). فانقُص: a damma over the qāf (2.9 x 4.7 pt). أيّها: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt). حسَبْتَ: a fatha over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). بَقِيَ: a fatha over the bā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt), which has its two dots (3.2 x 1.8 pt). حاصَّة: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); so too on L18 (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). وان: no hamza.

L18: للزُّهَرَة: over the zāy a shadda with a damma above it and over the hā' a fatha, which is joined to the shadda: the three signs make one cluster (7.6 x 6.5 pt), in both copies; and a fatha over the rā' (4.0 x 2.9 pt). وعُطارِدَ: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (2.9 x 2.5 pt). فإِنّ: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a shadda over the nūn (3.2 x 2.5 pt). يخرُج: a damma over the rā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt). الجَدْوَل: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.8 pt).

figures.note: the figure of chapter 44 for the eclipse of the sun: two circles about one centre, the outer one of the half of the two diameters and the inner one of the sun; the upright diameter of the outer circle, with ب at its top (the south) and د at its foot (the north), and its level diameter, with ج at its left end (the east) and ا at its right end (the west); three small circles of one size, of the moon: one at the right and one at the lower left, whose centres lie on the outer circle and are marked ق and س, and one below the centre of the figure, about a point of the upright diameter that is marked with a filled dot, ح beside it; and four more lines: from the centre of the figure, where ه stands, to ق and to س, and two level lines, from the upright diameter, where ع stands, to ق, and from س to the upright diameter, where م stands; with the letters ز, ط, ن, ك, ض and ل inside the figure and the words «جنوب», «مشرق», «مغرب» and «شمال» at the top, the left, the right and the foot. Measured with tools_s10/fig_measure.py at 600 dpi (scratch fig/spec981.json): the five circles and the six lines are least-squares fits to their ink (stroke centres and widths); the two diameters are drawn to their meeting with the fitted outer circle, the lines from the centre and from ع from the upright diameter to the end of their ink at ق and at س, and the line from س from its meeting with the line from the centre (the letter س touches it there) to the upright diameter. The centres of the two outer small circles lie on the fitted outer circle within 0.05 pt. The filled dot (3.5 pt across) is measured on its ink at 1200 dpi; it stands 0.7 pt from the fitted centre of its circle, and the upright diameter has a gap of 0.6 pt under it, which is not redrawn. The twenty letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink; ط, ض, س and the last letter of «مغرب» touch the drawing and are measured on their ink away from the fitted lines and circles
